shortDescription: Module to manage data centers in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: compatibility_version
options.description: Compatibility version of the data center.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: force
options.description: This parameter can be used only when removing a data center. If I(True) data center will be forcibly removed, even though it contains some clusters. Default value is I(False), which means that only empty data center can be removed.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the datacenter to manage.

options.name: iscsi_bonds
options.description: List of iscsi bonds, which should be created in datacenter.

options.name: local
options.description: I(True) if the data center should be local, I(False) if should be shared. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: mac_pool
options.description: MAC pool to be used by this datacenter. IMPORTANT: This option is deprecated in oVirt/RHV 4.1. You should use C(mac_pool) in C(ovirt_clusters) module, as MAC pools are set per cluster since 4.1.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the data center to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: quota_mode
options.description: Quota mode of the data center. One of I(disabled), I(audit) or I(enabled)

options.name: state
options.description: Should the data center be present or absent.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
